coverage_gaps: Only PubMed is available, so independent subject indexes, citation graphs, DOI metadata services, trial registries, regulator databases, preprint servers, patent sources, and chemistry databases cannot be searched.
Backward and forward citation expansion is limited to author, locus, alias, and related-record searching expressible in PubMed; complete citation-network traversal cannot be guaranteed.
PubMed coverage and abstract detail may be incomplete for early linkage reports, non-English articles, conference material, structural datasets, and the newest online-first records.
The 12-event cap permits one combined recent challenge/update query; unresolved post-2020 terminology or ancestry-specific signals may require a later dedicated update search.

Direct claims about physiological substrates may remain assay-, tissue-, species-, or perturbation-dependent when full methods or underlying phosphoproteomic data are unavailable from the indexed record.
exclusion_criteria: Records that mention LRRK2 only incidentally and provide no evidence about Parkinson disease genetics, enzymatic mechanism, physiological substrates, or limits on those claims.
Non-Parkinson disorders or general kinase and Rab biology lacking an explicit, testable connection to LRRK2-associated Parkinson disease mechanism.
Narrative reviews, editorials, or commentaries used as the sole support for a genetic, enzymatic, or substrate conclusion.

Purely predicted interactors, sequence motifs, docking results, or overexpression-only phosphorylation observations classified as physiological substrates without direct biochemical and endogenous validation.
Studies of pharmacological compounds lacking adequate target-engagement or selectivity evidence when used to infer an LRRK2-specific mechanism.
Duplicate bibliographic records, while preserving every query-to-record occurrence and retaining corrections, errata, and retractions as linked records rather than discarding them.
inclusion_criteria: PubMed records with a publication date on or before 2024-12-31; retrieve broadly, then enforce the cutoff after retrieval when online-first, issue, or correction dates are ambiguous.
Primary human genetic studies addressing LRRK2 or PARK8 linkage, segregation, association, ancestry, penetrance, genotype-phenotype relationships, or neuropathology in Parkinson disease.
Primary biochemical, structural, cellular, animal, or patient-derived studies that directly test LRRK2 kinase, ROC-COR GTPase, conformational, localization, or substrate mechanisms.
Substrate studies that identify a defined phosphosite or test endogenous target phosphorylation with genetic perturbation, selective inhibition, orthogonal assays, or in vivo material.
Null, negative, conflicting, replication, correction, and retraction records relevant to genetic causality, variant generality, enzymatic activation, or physiological substrate claims.
Reviews and meta-analyses used for terminology expansion, chronology, and primary-record discovery, with decisive mechanistic claims traced to primary studies.
All organisms, experimental systems, ancestries, and languages are eligible at retrieval, with organism, model, ancestry, assay context, and publication type retained during screening.

queries.purpose: Recover the independent 2004 genetic-discovery anchors and verify the LRRK2, PARK8, and dardarin terminology.
queries.query: (((Paisan-Ruiz C[Author] AND 2004[Date - Publication]) OR (Zimprich A[Author] AND 2004[Date - Publication])) AND (LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR PARK8[Title/Abstract] OR dardarin[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Parkinson Disease"[Mesh] OR parkinson*[Title/Abstract])) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Recover an early enzymatic-mechanism anchor testing whether disease-associated mutations alter LRRK2 kinase activity.
queries.query: (West AB[Author] AND LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND ("augment kinase activity"[Title/Abstract] OR kinase[Title/Abstract]) AND (mutation*[Title/Abstract] OR G2019S[Title/Abstract] OR R1441C[Title/Abstract])) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.query: (Steger M[Author] AND LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND (Rab[Title/Abstract] OR "Rab GTPases"[Title/Abstract]) AND (phosphoproteom*[Title/Abstract] OR phosphorylat*[Title/Abstract])) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.query: ((LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract]) AND (kinase[Title/Abstract] OR GTPase[Title/Abstract] OR substrate*[Title/Abstract] OR Rab10[Title/Abstract] OR "Rab GTPase"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("no increase"[Title/Abstract] OR unchanged[Title/Abstract] OR normal[Title/Abstract] OR dispensable[Title/Abstract] OR indirect[Title/Abstract] OR conflicting[Title/Abstract] OR "assay dependent"[Title/Abstract] OR "model dependent"[Title/Abstract] OR off-target[Title/Abstract] OR replication[Title/Abstract] OR correction[Publication Type] OR retraction[Publication Type])) AND ("1900/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Seek recent null, population-specific, penetrance-limiting, replication, correction, and retraction evidence and provide the temporal update through the as-of date.
queries.query: ((LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR PARK8[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Parkinson Disease"[Mesh] OR parkinson*[Title/Abstract]) AND (penetrance[Title/Abstract] OR expressivity[Title/Abstract] OR ancestry[Title/Abstract] OR "population specific"[Title/Abstract] OR "no association"[Title/Abstract] OR "not associated"[Title/Abstract] OR control*[Title/Abstract] OR unaffected[Title/Abstract] OR replication[Title/Abstract] OR meta-analysis[Title/Abstract] OR correction[Publication Type] OR retraction[Publication Type])) AND ("2020/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

question_frame: Target-mechanism frame: from PubMed inception through 2024-12-31, trace how LRRK2/PARK8 was genetically linked to Parkinson disease, distinguish pathogenic, risk, protective, and uncertain variants across ancestries, define the kinase and ROC-COR GTPase mechanism, evaluate endogenous physiological substrates and downstream biology, and retrieve penetrance, replication, variant-specific, model-specific, null, conflicting, correction, and retraction evidence that constrains causal strength or generality.
stop_rules: Execute all 12 planned PubMed query events, preserve the exact query and wave for each event, and apply the 2024-12-31 publication cutoff after retrieval.

Do not close the genetic-discovery branch until the independent 2004 discovery anchors are recovered and the earlier PARK8 linkage history is represented; report anchor failure if recovery is impossible within the query cap.
Do not close the enzymatic branch until evidence for both kinase and ROC-COR GTPase functions is represented and major pathogenic variants are compared rather than generalized from G2019S alone.

Do not close the substrate branch until the Rab phosphoproteomic anchor is recovered and at least one proposed substrate has direct biochemical plus endogenous genetic or pharmacological validation, or the absence of such validation is documented.

Do not close the limitations branch until distinct challenge searches have assessed genetic penetrance and population generality, variant-specific enzymatic effects, substrate directness, model dependence, null findings, corrections, and retractions.
Stop author, locus, and related-record expansion after two consecutive screened PubMed result batches add no new decision-relevant variant, mechanism, substrate, or limiting-evidence category.
Merge records by stable identifiers while preserving all query-to-record links; fail closed and flag the conflict when duplicate records disagree on identity or bibliographic facts.

Stop at the 12-query-event cap even if saturation is incomplete, and report any unrecovered anchor, unsearched alias, unresolved contradiction, or evidence class unavailable through PubMed as a coverage gap.
